extracted.intended_audience: prospective and current USPTO patent and trademark practitioners; inventors seeking practitioner help
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on who may represent applicants before the USPTO (patent practitioners and trademark practitioners), the qualifications and procedural resources for registration, and OED's role in exam administration, discipline, and related programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent practitioner registration requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Registered patent practitioners are individuals who have passed the USPTO's registration exam and met the qualifications to represent patent applicants before the USPTO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See 'Becoming a patent practitioner' for applying for registration to practice in patent matters, including specific requirements, forms, and exam information. OED administers the registration exam and maintains the roster of current patent practitioners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark practitioner qualification
rubrics_metrics.description: Trademark practitioners are attorneys who are active members in good standing of the bar of the highest court of any State.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See 'Becoming a trademark practitioner' for details on requirements to represent others in trademark matters before the USPTO.

rubrics_metrics.name: OED administration of registration exam and roster
rubrics_metrics.description: The Office of Enrollment and Discipline (OED) administers the registration exam and maintains a roster of current patent practitioners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review 'Registration exam update' and the OED-maintained roster and 'Registration to practice notices' for current procedural information about exam offerings and registration status.

rubrics_metrics.name: OED disciplinary and grievance processes
rubrics_metrics.description: OED investigates grievances submitted against practitioners and provides public information about disciplinary actions against practitioners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disciplinary actions and related notices are published and made available to the public; consult OED resources and Official Gazette/Federal Register notices for details and case information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethics rules and practitioner responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Current patent and trademark practitioners should follow applicable ethics rules and use common forms and online access provided for practice before the USPTO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See 'Information for current practitioners' for ethics rules, commonly used forms, and online practitioner services and access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Pro Bono Program coordination
rubrics_metrics.description: OED coordinates a nationwide Patent Pro Bono Program for under-resourced inventors seeking free legal help.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program connects eligible inventors with volunteer registered practitioners; consult OED program pages for eligibility criteria and how to request pro bono assistance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Law School Clinic Certification Program
rubrics_metrics.description: OED administers a Law School Clinic Certification Program where law students gain experience in intellectual property law.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Law school clinics may be certified to represent clients before the USPTO under program rules; consult the OED clinic certification materials for program requirements and procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Becoming a patent practitioner (resource requirement summary)
rubrics_metrics.description: Information covering how to apply for registration to practice in patent matters before the USPTO, including requirements, forms, and exam information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prospective registrants should review the becoming-a-practitioner guidance to understand educational/experience prerequisites, application forms, exam procedures, and supporting documentation required by OED.

rubrics_metrics.name: Finding a patent practitioner (eligibility indicator)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on how to find registered patent agents and attorneys who are eligible to practice before the USPTO in patent matters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only individuals who appear on the USPTO roster (i.e., who have met registration requirements) are eligible to represent patent applicants before the USPTO; use USPTO search tools to verify registration status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Becoming a trademark practitioner (resource requirement summary)
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on the requirements to represent others in trademark matters before the USPTO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prospective trademark practitioners must be attorneys admitted and in good standing before the highest court of a State; consult the USPTO guidance for any additional procedural steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Finding a trademark practitioner (locator guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on how to find attorneys who practice trademark law.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use USPTO resources and attorney directories to locate trademark practitioners; confirm attorney bar standing as part of selection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration to practice notices and lists
rubrics_metrics.description: Public notices and a list of individuals seeking registration to practice before the USPTO are made available for review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review the published list of applicants seeking registration (and related notices) to track pending registrations and procedural deadlines or to verify application status.

rubrics_metrics.name: OED Federal Register and Official Gazette notices
rubrics_metrics.description: OED publishes notices in the Federal Register and the USPTO Official Gazette.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult these official publications for authoritative notices regarding registration, discipline, program changes, and other OED actions.
